title: MagSafe Monday: MOFT’s Trackable Field Wallet holds eight cards, cash, and supports Find My
summary:
The one thing Apple’s own MagSafe wallet does that a few third-party wallets have is Find My. If you misplace your wallet, your iPhone tells you where it is. summary:

Since Siri AI’s launch in iOS 27.0, the system has enforced guardrails that do not allow it to access data from the Health app, despite the older Siri Classic being able to do just that.

However, it seems Apple is about to close the gap. In the latest iOS 27.3 beta, just released to developers today, users are now able to ask their iPhone about health data related questions and Siri AI will answer.
